passing_score.verbatim: The test will consist of multiple choice questions based on information contained in sections B and C of this manual.

exam_facts.note: Manual Section A-4 (physical p35, printed 21) says the knowledge test is multiple choice, based on Sections B and C, approximately 25% each traffic signs and signals, safe driving principles, rules of the road, drugs and alcohol; computerized, with Spanish, Korean or Japanese alternates. It states no question count, no passing score or percent and no time limit anywhere (full-text search for pass/percent/questions/correct/score found none) - nulls are genuine absences, not imported from memory. Physical page = printed page + 14 for the body. Section C Chapter 4's driving-experience log form (physical p133), covers, TOC and the back cover are not mapped; motorcycle and CDL classes point to separate manuals.
